name: audio_device
description: Switch which audio device the computer and FRED use, or list them: speakers, headphones, earbuds, a headset, the monitor's speakers, a microphone. The user says it in their own words (my headphones, the new earbuds, the lavalier mic); FRED works out which connected device is meant, from the device names, the meaning of the words, what it remembers the user calls things, and by elimination. A headset with a microphone switches speaker and microphone together.

action.description: switch (default) changes the device; list says which devices are connected and paired; remember_alias is internal, never use it

device.description: for switch: the device exactly as the user said it, e.g. 'my new earbuds', 'speakers', 'the monitor', 'the lavalier mic'

kind.description: auto (default) decides from the words: microphone words mean input, headsets switch both

as_word.description: internal follow-up only, never set it

examples: change the output to the speakers
switch the microphone to the headset
which audio devices do I have
not_for: the loudness of the speakers (use volume)
